body.p: Claims 21-40 are currently pending. Consideration of the pending claims, namely, claims 21-40 is respectfully requested. By the present amendment, claim 21 is amended and claim 25 is cancelled

In the Office Action Examiner Kurr indicated that claims 25 is objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. Claim 22 would be rejected under Statutory Double Patenting if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. Claims 30-40 would be allowable upon filing a terminal disclaimer. Applicant's representatives extend our appreciation to Examiner Kurr for the recognition of allowable subject matter.

Claims 21-40 are rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1-20 of U.S. Patent No. 11806122 B2. Applicant is filing a terminal disclaimer to overcome the double patenting rejections and notice to that effect is respectfully requested. Should Examiner Kurr disagree, they are encouraged to contact the undersigned to discuss.

If any fees are determined to be due in connection with filing this Amendment or any other paper filed during prosecution of this application, the Commissioner is authorized to charge any such fees to deposit account no. 60-5050.
